special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Shatter.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 60 (11d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

legendary_actions.name: Cloaked Flight
legendary_actions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Invisibility on itself, and it can fly up to half its Fly Speed. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Sonic Boom
legendary_actions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Shatter. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Swipe
legendary_actions.description: The dragon makes one Rend attack.
